answer_text:
Published research does not specify a single exact total for "local business recommendation questions" alone, though studies tracking Perplexity's citation behavior in September 2026 provide broad domain counts for related local and service-based queries:
UX Continuum Study: In published research analyzing assistant responses for service and recommendation queries, Perplexity cited an average of 20.0 sources per answer, relying heavily on directories (37.1% of citations for local services) and company websites (50.2% across hiring/recommendation categories). Read the full analysis at UX Continuum Research.
Lil Big Things / AuthorityTech Studies: Broader September 2026 industry datasets tracking AI-generated answers and topic-local citations note that Perplexity scanned 2,428 different domains in specific industry recommendation sets, or 15,447 distinct domains across major answer runs, while niche-focused local or topic studies evaluated specific subsets (such as 377 total cited domains in specialized vertical breakdowns). You can review methodology notes via AuthorityTech Blog.
